d: Prashant Kishor On Nitish Setu : jan suraj ke sansthapak prashant kishor ne pradhanmantri narendr modi ke bihar daure aur unke vikas se jure davon par saval uthae hain. unhonne bihar men 43 lakh logon ko ghar die jane ke dave par sarkar se labharthiyon ki suchi ya jile aur prakhandvar aankre jari karne ki mang ki. bihar men rojgar aur phaiktriyon ki sthiti par saval uthate hue unhonne kaha ki bari sankhya men bihari yuva gujrat aur dusre rajyon men majduri karne ja rahe hain.
